recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑（下方粉紅色）旁的骨髓腔被大型腫瘤細胞取代，細胞核呈泡狀、核仁明顯，細胞質豐富偏嗜酸性，背景是淡粉紅色纖維網狀的神經氈（neuropil），提示神經分化，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤（neuroblastoma）。
features: Marrow space adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by a tumor infiltrate with loss of normal hematopoiesis
Large pleomorphic tumor cells with round vesicular nuclei and conspicuous, often single, nucleoli
Moderate to abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm; some cells polygonal and ganglion-like
Pale eosinophilic fibrillary background matrix consistent with neuropil
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional bizarre nuclei
No Homer Wright rosettes identified in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows marrow spaces adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by a metastatic tumor with effacement of normal hematopoietic elements. The tumor cells are large, with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, set within a pale fibrillary neuropil-like background. Mitotic figures are present; Homer Wright rosettes are not identified. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma with differentiating features; confirmation with PHOX2B, synaptophysin, or chromogranin immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rhabdomyoblasts have dense eosinophilic cytoplasm with cross-striations and no fibrillary neuropil, and are desmin/myogenin positive.
Ewing sarcoma consists of uniform small round cells with scant clear cytoplasm lacking neuropil and ganglionic differentiation, and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma rather than neuropil and is cytokeratin positive.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or megakaryocytic hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive, without fibrillary neuropil.
